tables.title: ADC register map and reset values
tables.text_helper: Table 77, "ADC register map and reset values", in section 16.13 (ADC register map) on page 344. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 17 registers: ADC_ISR, ADC_IER, ADC_CR, ADC_CFGR1, ADC_CFGR2, ADC_SMPR, Reserved, ADC_AWD1TR, ADC_AWD2TR, ADC_CHSELR (CHSELRMOD=  0), ADC_CHSELR (CHSELRMOD=  1), ADC_AWD3TR and 5 more.
